items.prompt: What does values.reserve(16) establish for a vector whose size is 2?

options.text: There are now 16 constructed values ready to index
The old end iterator can always be dereferenced
options.why: end is never an element to dereference.

options.text: Capacity is at least 16; size remains 2
options.why: Only existing element indices are valid.

options.text: All future appends are forever guaranteed not to reallocate
options.why: Growing beyond actual capacity can reallocate.

items.explanation: Storage capacity does not create live elements; access must remain within size.
